items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.2 as technical measures to locate the escape and establish wetting; not excluded by 4.3(b) as this is not repair of the pool installation but detection. Reference case 63 and price prior.

Repair of the source installation (pool supply pipe) is excluded by 2.4.4 and 4.3(b); the pool and its pipework are not insured property, so neither repair nor associated labour/materials are indemnified.

Labour hours on an invoice predominantly for detection and repair of the excluded pool pipe; under 7.1.10 and 7.1.8(a), hours are allocated to the non-indemnifiable element when the invoice is mainly for excluded work.
Materials for repair of the excluded pool supply pipe are not indemnified per 2.4.4, 4.3(b), and 7.1.8(a).
Covered under 5.2.2 as technical measures to establish extent of wetting; not excluded. Reference cases 63, 59, and price prior.
Covered as emergency/mitigation under 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(b); removal of standing water from affected rooms is indemnified. Reference case 63 and price prior.
Drying of affected rooms is covered under 7.1.7(b); both pool and conservatory are one affected room per 7.1.5. Reference case 63 and price prior.
Rental of drying equipment for affected room is covered under 7.1.7(b); reference cases 63, 65, 21 and price prior.
Rental of drying equipment for affected room is covered under 7.1.7(b); reference case 63 and price prior.
Replacement of affected skirting in the conservatory is covered under 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.5; reference cases 63, 59, 36, 61 and price prior.
Loose-furnishings extension for the conservatory is on the schedule (per damage description); cleaning/drying of affected insured furnishing is covered under 7.1.7(f). Reference case 63.
Inspection/testing of building's own electrical installation reached by water is covered under 7.1.7(g); reference case 63 and price prior.

Inspection of the pool plant is not indemnified: the pool and its technical plant are excluded property under 4.3(b), and 7.1.8(b) excludes inspection/testing of an excluded installation even if in the affected room.

items.description: Upgrade to high-quality natural stone floor (12 m²)
items.rationale: Upgrade to a higher-grade floor is not indemnified per 7.1.9 and 7.1.8(c); only the standard-grade equivalent is covered, and this line is itemised as an upgrade.
Servicing/maintenance of the pool filter is not indemnified per 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(b); maintenance of an excluded installation is always excluded, even if performed after a loss.
Making good affected wall render is covered under 7.1.7(a) and (c); only the wetted band is included per 7.1.5. Reference case 63 and price prior.
Final cleaning of the working area after covered works is indemnified under 7.1.7(h); reference case 63 and price prior.
One attendance/vehicle charge per invoice with indemnifiable work is covered under 7.1.8(e) and 11.3; this invoice contains covered work.
